title: Convert RLum-class objects to the XLUM format — convert_rlum2xlum
text: function tries make best possible conversion Luminescence::RLum object XLUM format. Supported Luminescence::RLum.Analysis objects well Luminescence::RLum.Data objects may contain. Luminescence::RLum.Results objects supported. input may single object list objects. list data objects combined single sequence, whereas list Luminescence::RLum.Analysis objects produces one <sequence/> per element. analysis record mapped <record/> node holding one <curve/> nodes. measured values stored text content <curve/> node, tValues, xValues, yValues kept node attributes. Additional record attributes, curveType startDate, transferred available. Luminescence::RLum objects distinguish different samples, <xlum/> <sample/> nodes created automatically, converted objects end single sample.
